title: Start a conversation
lead: Send an investment, partnership or demo enquiry in the local preview.
description: This form creates a synthetic local test receipt only. No email is sent and no external delivery is implied.

sections.title: Before you write
paragraphs: Choose a topic and share a concise question. Do not enter personal health information or confidential material into this preview.

sections.title: An email alternative
paragraphs: You may use your own email client to write to info@artifactory.tech. The address is a supplied candidate and has not been verified by the operator.

sections.title: What happens here
paragraphs: The local test receiver holds synthetic submissions in memory for at most 24 hours and clears them on restart.
